invariants.termination: Each failed Control returns exit 4 CommitUnknown without a committed owner release. Parent absent, destination flock available, scratch empty and zero actual Control/catalog backends. Subsequent owner epochs 5,6,7 have distinct process incarnations. Final stop exits 0 with release. These are terminal observations, not continuous driver-custody evidence.
invariants.recovery: Independent SQL time bounds a fresh original issue instant, deadline grows and xmin changes after recovery. Two continuations of the same first cursor return the independently expected rows; original 900-second lifetime, expiry+30-second retention and full retention row/xmin remain unchanged.

not_qualified: Held COMMIT/reply, cancellation/custody, delivery failures, expired cursor/session, changed policy/grants/TTL/skew and mixed/aged/exhausted workloads remain open.
